# IBM Cloud Code Engine — Engine Room

> The Engine Room is the official blog and code-sample hub for IBM Cloud Code Engine.
> It covers serverless apps, batch jobs, GPU workloads, serverless fleets, functions, and related IBM Cloud topics.

## Blog posts

- [Quantum Notebooks in the Cloud: Run Qiskit in JupyterLab on IBM Cloud Code Engine](https://ibm.github.io/CodeEngine/posts/qiskit-jupyterlab-on-code-engine/): Deploy a persistent, password-protected JupyterLab with Qiskit to IBM Cloud Code Engine and run quantum workloads on IBM Quantum hardware, with one config file and one script. (2026-10-21)
- [IBM Cloud Code Engine Fleets Just Got More Flexible: Keep Fleets Alive and Submit Tasks Anytime](https://ibm.github.io/CodeEngine/posts/dynamic-fleets-availability/): IBM Cloud Code Engine Serverless Fleets are getting more powerful. Create a fleet once, tune it for your latency requirements, then submit tasks to it over time. Eliminated are repetitive configurations, and infrastructure overhead. (2026-09-04)
- [Remote Bob: Run Bob Shell in IBM Cloud Code Engine](https://ibm.github.io/CodeEngine/posts/remote-bob-run-bob-shell-in-the-cloud/): Spin up a full Bob Shell terminal running autonomously in IBM Cloud Code Engine — sandboxed, persistent, and accessible from any browser in under 20 minutes. (2026-09-01)
- [From Laptop to Cloud in Minutes: Deploying with Bob and Code Engine](https://ibm.github.io/CodeEngine/posts/deploy-from-bob/): Using Bob to deploy an app to Code Engine (2026-07-02)

No manual build steps, no infrastructure management—just point Code Engine at your source code and deploy. (2026-06-08)
